GNPS Civic Readiness Portal — admin / leadership share package
================================================================

Forwardable artifacts in this folder, in suggested reading order:

  00 — Leadership Meeting Brief          — for the meeting itself
  01 — Design Document (archived)        — historical prototype artifact only
  02 — IT Handoff Brief (8 pages)        — for GNPS Technology Department
  03 — Executive Summary (4 pages)       — for leadership / Board / quick reads
  04 — IT Runbook                        — full deployment + ops procedures
  05 — Infinite Campus Integration       — IC wiring guide for SIS team
  06 — Teacher Quick-Push Workflow       — onboarding doc for teachers
  07 — Sample IC CSV                     — exact format the importer expects,
                                          including the Regents safety-net /
                                          appeal / 45-variance flag

Current source docs also include:
  docs/meeting-brief.md                  — current talking points and demo path
  docs/go-live-checklist.md              — demo / pilot / production boundary
  docs/project-goal-and-rollout-plan.md  — project goal, research baseline,
                                          IC auto-population split, rollout

Source code (MIT, public): https://github.com/SirhanMacx/gnps-civic-readiness
Latest release:            https://github.com/SirhanMacx/gnps-civic-readiness/releases/tag/v0.2.0

Meeting framing:
  This is a serious prototype and a fully self-hostable v0.2.0 codebase.
  Infinite Campus remains the system of record. The portal is the workflow,
  evidence, and audit layer. Real student data belongs only in a district-
  approved environment; the public demo is for sample-data review.

Suggested forwarding plan
-------------------------

  → To leadership / Board:           00, 03, 02 (PDFs)
  → To GNPS Technology dept:         00, 02, 04, 05 (PDFs)
  → To Curriculum & Instruction:     00, 03 (PDFs)
  → To future teachers in pilot:     06 (PDF)

Questions: civicseal@greatneck.k12.ny.us
